title: Defi Shulker
description: Shulker Challenge: A unique nomadic survival data pack! Move 150 blocks every 5 days or face severe penalties!
body:
# Shulker Challenge

A survival challenge where staying still is forbidden! This datapack forces you to adopt a **100% nomadic** lifestyle by compelling you to continuously explore the world.

---

## How it works
Right when you spawn, you receive **5 Shulker Boxes** of different colors. These are your only chests for the entire adventure! Store your resources inside, because you will have to carry them everywhere.

---

## The Timer
An invisible **5-day Minecraft** timer (120,000 ticks) starts. 
* A chat message appears when only **1 day** remains.
* A large title flashes on your screen when **10 seconds** are left.

---

## The Penalties
If the timer hits **0**:
* A red warning message is displayed.
* You receive **Hunger III** and **Slowness II** effects.
* These penalties stay active until you move to a new area.

---

## How to reset the effects?
To stop the penalties and reset the timer back to 5 days, you must **relocate**. 
As soon as you travel more than **150 blocks** away from your campsite, the system validates your exploration, displays a green message, and resets the clock!
